items.title: Bob Stewart interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 24, 2006
items.q: you see him in movies with Louis Armstrong in the background

ctx.x: Yeah he was a great tuba player. Yeah. I mean he was playing with Lester Young all through most of the forties and during — you see him in movies with Louis Armstrong in the background of one of those movies where he’s wearing this straw hat, you know, one of those flat brim hats. But he was a great tuba player.
Was it partly volume and partly just the physical limitations of the instruments that you couldn’t walk all night?
